guide_note: Guides are our own words, written for this entry. Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it on 18 Nov 2026. Advice drawn from a description is labelled as our reading, not yet checked in-game.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks on its own. There is no separate task — it is the sum of everything else in this guide. Work the roadmap in order and it lands last.
sources: Official name, description & grade — Exophase / PSNProfiles list, 18 Nov 2026
Route: our reading of the official list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story mission of the game. It unlocks through normal story play; nothing before it can be missed.
sources: Official name, description & grade — Exophase / PSNProfiles list, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.name: A Long Road
